description.value: The Quarterdeck Inn is an oceanfront resort and marina in Port Hardy, the northern terminus of Vancouver Island — a natural start or finish point for cyclists completing the Island Highway. The property offers 40 rooms and suites ranging from standard rooms to ocean-view apartments with full kitchens, set along Hardy Bay with sweeping coastal views. An independently operated Mexican-inspired restaurant (Oceanside Cantina) sits on-site, and the attached marina is one of the largest on northern Vancouver Island.

address.value: 6555 Hardy Bay Road, Port Hardy, V0N 2P0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich amenity detail across multiple subpages. Neither required cycling criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is mentioned anywhere on the site, so both remain null. Optional amenities are well-supported: laundry is explicitly listed as a hotel amenity ('Coin Laundry Facility-Next Door (Marina side)'), a vending machine is listed in hotel amenities, Wi-Fi is confirmed in rooms and public spaces, a grab-and-go breakfast is mentioned on the front page, and on-site evening dining is provided by the independently operated Oceanside Cantina. All contact details on the website match OSM exactly.
concerns: Website uses both 'Quarterdeck Resort & Marina' and 'Quarterdeck Inn Port Hardy' interchangeably as the business name, while OSM records only 'Quarterdeck Inn'. Not a critical discrepancy but worth noting.
No mention of bike storage or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service hotel at a key cycling destination (Port Hardy, northern Vancouver Island terminus), but neither required criterion — secure bike storage nor staff bike procedure — is mentioned anywhere on the website. Direct contact is needed to confirm suitability for WWC listing.

Laundry.detail: Coin Laundry Facility listed as a hotel amenity, located next door on the Marina side; laundry also available at the marina

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Website front page states 'Guests can start their day with a convenient grab-and-go breakfast.'

Nearby evening food.detail: Oceanside Cantina on-site serves Mexican-inspired cuisine including dinner, 7 days a week

Vending machines.detail: Vending Machine explicitly listed under Hotel Amenities on the /amenities/ page
